## GW150914

On 14 September 2015, the two LIGO detectors (Hanford H1, Livingston L1) observed, for the first time, two black holes merging.

Whitening divides by the noise spectrum $S_n(f)$ to even out the weight of each frequency.

$$\tilde h_w(f) = \frac{\tilde h(f)}{\sqrt{S_n(f)}}$$

Just before the merger, the gravitational wave's frequency rises as $f \propto (t_c - t)^{-3/8}$ (the chirp).

Change the pass band of **whiten** (f_low, f_high) and rerun just that Card.
